plausibility.question: P1 gravity
plausibility.answer: Panels stand on the plate top and the brackets on the plate (clearance 0.000, interference 0.000); the lid's side skirts rest on the panel tops at y 215; nothing hangs on a screw alone.

plausibility.question: P2 function chains
plausibility.answer: No air, liquid, drive or cable passes through the new parts; the panels close the sides 5.000 from the electronics tray and 3.000 from OD-C11, whose vents stay the bay's exhaust.

plausibility.question: P3 moving parts
plausibility.answer: No moving parts; every assembly path (brackets down, panels in, lid down) reads 0.000 mm3 at every 1.0 step.

plausibility.question: P4 grip, reach, insertion
plausibility.answer: Bracket screws driven from above along a clear r 4 axis (panels and lid off); panel screws from outside along X with 20 clear; panels offered inward onto the brackets; lid lowered last; the order of spec sec. 4 is the only one that fits.

plausibility.question: P5 nothing absurd
plausibility.answer: A 3 mm printed side wall with a top rail and a 60 deg locating lip on three corner brackets is ordinary printed-enclosure practice; the proud button heads and the rear-corner slit are ledgered (A-07, A-03).

plausibility.question: P6 floating, embedded, mirrored, upside-down
plausibility.answer: Every designed contact reads 0.000 with no interference; the left panel is a true mirror with its relief on the inner face over OD-C07; the lips point up inside the skirts; the left brackets face their insert bores at x -117.
